name: BackdoorBench
description: BackdoorBench is a comprehensive benchmark for backdoor learning in AI systems, integrating implementations of 20 attack and 32 defense algorithms. It provides extensive evaluations across multiple models and datasets, along with analysis tools and a user-friendly website including codebase, leaderboard, and model zoo.
general_score_metric: attack success rate / clean accuracy trade-off
reputation: Widely used in the backdoor-learning community as a standard, open benchmark with a large suite of attacks, defenses, and leaderboards.
notes: Includes 11,492 attack-against-defense evaluations; provides 23 analysis tools; aims to standardize backdoor learning evaluation.
